title: Pool, Balcony, Walk to Downtown Broadway + Garage
description:
Experience luxury in the HYVE building. City view condo in an unbeatable location - walk to Downtown Broadway or the Gulch for endless food & shopping. This building has a pool, fire pit, lounge chairs, gym & common areas to work from. Parking available in a garage. Enjoy your morning coffee on our private balcony. Only 0.5 mi to Broadway & 0.6 mi to the Gulch! Premium hardwood floors, fully equipped kitchen, and a washer/dryer. Near incredible bars, live music venues, shopping & so much more.

The space
HIGHLIGHTS:

★ Walk to Downtown Nashville Broadway Bars
★ City view
★ 2 King Beds, Queen-over-Queen Bunk Bed, 1 Sleeper Sofa
★ Private balcony with outdoor seating
★ Pool with lounge chairs, cabanas, and a fire pit
★ State-of-the-art fitness center with Peloton equipment
★ Common space in the building to work or lounge at
★ Highly Secure building with key code entry
★ Free Luggage storage available at the building from 10a - 4pm Thursday through Sunday
★ Free parking in the attached garage. Please note this is on a first come, first serve basis. 
★ Smart TVs in the living room and 2 bedrooms 
★ High-speed wifi
★ Washer/Dryer in the condo
★ Dedicated space with mirrors + seating for 4 to get ready for a night on the town!
★ Dining Table + Kitchen island with seating
★ Fully equipped kitchen for all of your cooking needs
★ Coffee maker + coffee
★ Hassle-free check-in with no keys, just codes
★ Elevator in the building
★ Walking distance to the Gulch, Music City Hall of Fame, Downtown Broadway Bars
★ Hair dryers, shampoo, conditioner and body wash provided
★ Plenty of closet storage space for your clothes & other items
★ Central AC + Heat
★ Sound machine in the bedrooms
★ Full length mirrors
★ Games & Books for your enjoyment

BEDS:
Bedroom 1: King Bed 
Bedroom 2: King Bed
Bedroom 2: Queen-over-Queen Bunk Bed 
Living Room: Sleeper Sofa

BATHROOMS:
Bathroom 1: Full size with shower/tub combo 
Bathroom 2:  Full size with standing shower and double vanity

This brand new luxury condo is impossible to beat - three spacious bedrooms, private balcony, pool, gym, walking distance to downtown, and all the high-end furnishings/supplies you could need for the ultimate stress-free stay. Highly sought-after and extremely secure, this building is located in the heart of Nashville's rich musical history and endlessly expanding food & entertainment options. Steps from Downtown and the Gulch - just 0.5 mile walk to the Country Music Hall of Fame, Broadway's endless restaurants, and honky tonks with live artists every night. Catch a show at Bridgestone Arena, or the famous Ryman Auditorium, both of which are a short 15 min walk! Located across the street from Jack White's record store and music venue, Third Man Records. You simply cannot beat this luxury accommodation or this location.

Walk To (alphabetical order):

★ Ascend Amphitheater
★ Bridgestone Arena (Predators)
★ City Winery Nashville
★ Country Music Hall of Fame
★ Fifth & Broadway food hall and shopping
★ Frist Art Museum
★ Germantown
★ Hard Rock
★ Honky Tonks
★ Listening Room Songwriter Cafe
★ Music City Center (Convention Center)
★ Shopping in the Gulch neighborhood's local boutiques like e.Allen and Rustler Hat Co.
★ Restaurants such as Biscuit Love, Husk, Martin's BBQ, Oak Steakhouse, Peg Leg Porker BBQ, Superica, Two Hands, Wildhorse Saloon and numerous others!
★ Ryman Auditorium
★ Schermerhorn Symphony
★Titans Stadium
★ Third Man Records
★ Yeehaw Brewing Co.

Guest access
You will have the entire house to yourself.

Other things to note
Free parking in the attached garage. Please note this is on a first come, first serve basis. It is not guaranteed. 

Nashville is growing quickly! There may be some construction around the area. We are located near an active train, which you will be able to hear. We provide sound machines in the bedrooms. 

We are located in the heart of the city, our area offers easy access to everything Nashville has to offer. Like many urban neighborhoods, you’ll see a diverse mix of people and activity.

Early check in times selected through the app are not applicable. If you would like early check in, you must message us.
